turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
That isn't an answer, Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so tell me who entered that zero, and when.
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then why does he have a zero, Hale? Kind words aren't a document. What do you have?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?

You're leading me, Hale, and I've spent twenty years watching people try. My son didn't cheat, overwhelmed or otherwise, and I'm writing down that you just said he did. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
